assessments.rationale: The audited V2 engine adds spot and perpetual base quantities to measure delta and targets one base quantity. That is valid only when both legs reference the same asset; it cannot net different assets, apply a cross-asset hedge ratio, or bound residual value risk.
The immutable metadata audit found only a current signed account commission surface and no complete historical 2023-2024 account-tier fee series.
Current documentation and synthetic declared rules do not establish the complete point-in-time 2023-2024 collateral, liquidation, fee, and ADL rule history.
Archive boundaries and current exchange information do not prove a complete point-in-time listing, suspension, status, and delisting history; the frozen policy requires fail-closed continuity.
Current futures tick, step, notional, and market-order filters cannot prove the rules that governed hypothetical 2023-2024 orders.
The signed endpoint exposes current leverage brackets, while the synthetic engine uses invented fixed rates; neither is immutable historical Binance bracket evidence.
The immutable metadata audit qualified settled funding timestamps, interval hours, and rates from official historical archives.
Current spot exchange information cannot prove the point-in-time tick, lot, notional, and order constraints in 2023-2024.
The immutable source census, pilot, and acquisition evidence qualify the required historical spot, perpetual, mark, index, and premium series source families.
The frozen timestamp-only V3P01 audit qualified 25 of 31 symbols against all predeclared synchronized coverage gates.

All 14 frozen same-asset synthetic scenarios passed for accounting, partial fills, rollback, idempotency, kill switch, and reconciliation; this pass does not cure the separate cross-asset risk failure.

limitations: Four requirements pass and seven fail; the all-required protocol therefore rejects V3P01 before primary selection.
No market numeric value, parameter, signal, trade, PnL, return, validation, holdout, or forward datum was inspected.
The 25-symbol timestamp qualification remains valid source evidence but cannot cure historical execution-state gaps.
The rejection does not claim cointegration is impossible or universally unprofitable; it records that Aurex cannot execute a qualified historical test from the frozen evidence.
The result selects no primary and grants no candidate, Pine, paper, sandbox, live, or capital permission.
The same-asset synthetic foundation proves useful lifecycle mechanics but not cross-asset identity, hedge, or residual risk.
V2 conservative metadata overrides were permitted only for protocol design and are explicitly insufficient for V3 primary selection.
